set.statement: When a run ends, whatever its outcome (merged, failed, abandoned), nothing its steps wrote to the temporary folder is left behind. Today the run's own {run_tmp} is already removed when it ends (internal/run/engine.go, and on abandon internal/api/run.go), but only what a workflow's [env] points there lands in it: the agents and commands of a workflow that sets no TMPDIR = "{run_tmp}" (this repo's workflows set only GOTMPDIR) write to the shared tmp, where nothing removes it. The daemon gives every process a run's steps start TMPDIR = {run_tmp} unless the workflow's [env] sets TMPDIR itself. The /tmp/rhiza-projection-* leak stays bug 01M7M3JZFW's. Measure: a test runs a workflow whose [env] names no {run_tmp} and whose step writes a file under $TMPDIR, ends the run each way, and finds nothing of it left under the tmp root.

Every outside intervention in a run is journalled and counted: a session message from outside the run, a manual resume, retry or abandon, an approve of anything other than a step the workflow itself asks the owner to approve, and a hand commit on the run's branch. Approving a workflow's own signoff (or other owner) step is the workflow working as written, not an intervention, and is not counted. Measure: a test makes each kind of intervention and sees each in rhiza run status --json and in the daemon's count; a run with none counts zero, and a run whose only owner action is approving its workflow's signoff step also counts zero.
